items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Chris had a guy to get the band together. His name was Clarence Page (PHONETIC). So I played with Clarence Page.

ctx.x: Yeah, Damon Hayes (PHONETIC). And so we -- I was -- and I left the band and come back to Cincinnati, and stayed with them -- well Chris had a guy to get the band together. His name was Clarence Page (PHONETIC). So I played with Clarence Page. He just died incidentally about two months ago now.
And he has a album of pictures that -- boy, that's the best album I've ever seen. And I was a very good friend of his. HI s wife promised to give me that album. You know, I wanted it.
